name: effect-fence-proceed-all-legs-confirmed
description: The ONE affirmative answer. Every leg of the fence cleared: the artifact is tracked and observed (version 1), the caller's expected_version matches, the read was not refused, the coordinator records a real content claim, the caller's digest equals that claim so the ownership generation is NOT demoted, expected_generation equals the recorded generation (0 for a first observation), and the SHARED grant from the preflight pre-read still stands. Pins that the proceed envelope carries verdict ONLY and no reason key -- a client branching on `reason` being absent is how it tells proceed from a hold whose reason it does not recognise. THIS FIXTURE IS ALSO THE CONTENT-HASH CONVENTION ANCHOR: content_hash is the lowercase sha-256 hex of the EXACT bytes of docs/plan.md, trailing spaces and newline included, and test_effect_fence_corpus.py recomputes it from setup.files rather than trusting the literal. A normalizing implementation (strip, rstrip, CRLF rewrite) produces a different digest, so the convention is tested here rather than only described in the guide.
_comment: python-only, following the 11-health-node-only / 09-status-default-tier-node-backend precedent for a surface one backend implements. The sibling Node coordinator's side of this contract is pinned by 13-node-sibling-does-not-implement-404.json.
